messages.author: 5657e1d4422ecd3a
messages.subject: MapR Support for rmr2
parts:
I have struggled with building and installing the rmr2 package on MapR.  MapR is fast becoming popular as a robust high availability Hadoop platform.  Unfortunately, the rmr2 build script doesn't work well for a MapR Hadoop installation.  Luckily all the problems were in the shell script src/hbase-io/build_linux.sh.  There were 2 kinds of differences:
  1. Incorrect wildcard patterns or paths for jar files
  2. Searching for an explicit version of apache-ant.  The version 1.8.4 is no longer available at the location searched.
Here are the differences between my script and the one in the official rmr2 package:

160,162c160,162
<     if [ ! -e apache-ant-1.9.0 ]; then
<         wget http://mirror.nus.edu.sg/apache/ant/binaries/apache-ant-1.9.0-bin.tar.gz
<         tar zxf apache-ant-1.9.0-bin.tar.gz
---
>     if [ ! -e apache-ant-1.8.4 ]; then
>         wget http://mirror.nus.edu.sg/apache/ant/binaries/apache-ant-1.8.4-bin.tar.gz
>         tar zxf apache-ant-1.8.4-bin.tar.gz
164c164
<     export PATH=apache-ant-1.9.0/bin:$PATH
---
>     export PATH=apache-ant-1.8.4/bin:$PATH
207,211c207,210
< # JVR - Fixed test to check in lib folder
< if ls ${hadoop_path}/lib/hadoop-*-core.jar; then
<     cp ${hadoop_path}/lib/hadoop-*-core.jar ./lib/
< elif ls ${hadoop_path}/lib/hadoop-core-*.jar; then
<     cp ${hadoop_path}/lib/hadoop-core-*.jar ./lib/
---
> if ls ${hadoop_path}/hadoop-*-core.jar; then
>     cp ${hadoop_path}/hadoop-*-core.jar ./lib/
> elif ls ${hadoop_path}/hadoop-core-*.jar; then
>     cp ${hadoop_path}/hadoop-core-*.jar ./lib/
218,220c217,218
< # JVR Fixed pattern
< if ls ${hadoop_path}/contrib/streaming/hadoop-*-streaming.jar &> /dev/null; then 
<     cp ${hadoop_path}/contrib/streaming/hadoop-*-streaming.jar ./lib/
---
> if ls ${hadoop_path}/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-*.jar &> /dev/null; then 
>     cp ${hadoop_path}/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-*.jar ./lib/

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: MapR Support for rmr2
parts:
Good catch but we need a solution with more legs, that is that can cover multiple platforms. If you don't use hbase IO formats, you can let this part of the build fail with no effect on all the other features, but that doesn't make that part of the build less in need of improvement.


Antonio
